Made by 주식회사 셀로닉스 · 2 times a day · 1 capsule

This product combines 32.4mg of Niacin, 66μg of Biotin, 15mg of Vitamin B1, 36μg of Vitamin B12, 17.4mg of Vitamin B2, 18.6mg of Vitamin B6, 510μg of Folate, 100mg of Coenzyme Q10, 10.8mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 capsule): 32.4mg Niacin, 66μg Biotin, 15mg Vitamin B1, 36μg Vitamin B12, 17.4mg Vitamin B2, 18.6mg Vitamin B6, 510μg Folate, 100mg Coenzyme Q10, 10.8mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 셀로닉스

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Coenzyme Q10
    • May help with antioxidant activity and lowering high blood pressure
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
